title: Interior and exterior look and space
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly mention the car’s interior and exterior appearance, with positive comments on looks and some undetermined references to roominess, maturity, seat trim, and storage.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the interior and exterior styling, textures, and overall visual appeal.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the interior feeling mature or roomy, seat coverings, luxury feel, and limited storage without enough context to confirm sentiment consistently.

limitations: Half of the topic reviews are undetermined, which limits confidence about the overall tone of several interior-related mentions.
Some sampled fragments are too short, such as single-word mentions of 'inside', to identify a clear sentiment.
The topic mixes exterior appearance, interior appearance, space, seat trim, luxury feel, and storage, so it is not a tightly focused single aspect.
